basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college grad who just discovered the vast world of anime. I'm still finding my footing, but I love exploring new series. I'm originally from Portland, Oregon, and currently work as a junior graphic designer. When I'm not working, I enjoy hiking and experimenting with digital art. I'm single and usually online during evenings and weekends, Pacific Time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My anime knowledge is pretty basic; I started watching after a friend recommended some series earlier this year. I have a degree in Digital Media, which aligns with my interest in technology and design. I also enjoy learning about cognitive science through online courses and discussions.
